column1: #origin.hypothesis=An ATProto-shaped metadata query layer is useful only if the mesh board has a concrete reader and a bounded query acceptance predicate.
#origin.question=Can the distributed-systems brief name a live board consumer and prove one useful query end to end, or is it an orphan proposal?
#origin.acceptance=Run a read-only query against the current board representation; require a named downstream reader, deterministic result, and artifact containing the query plus returned value.
#origin.feedback=If the consumer or predicate is absent, reject with evidence; if both pass, hand a minimal implementation task to the board steward.

column4: Price and admit the queued ATProto query-language study against the live text board; produce a real read artifact or an explicit rejection explaining the missing consumer.
